items.titleZh: 赫塔获得FP1超级驾照积分，可申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛
items.summaryZh: 赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事，获得积分，可申请超级驾照；凯迪拉克确认赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
items.originalTitle: Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGP
items.summaryEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
detailZh:
赫塔完成100公里FP1赛事获得积分，因此他现在可以申请超级驾照 #F1 #巴西大奖赛Chris Medland：凯迪拉克确认，科顿·赫塔将在Interlagos进行另一场FP1赛事，以获得最后的超级驾照积分。
一场干净的FP1赛事，只要跑足足够的里程，将允许他申请超级驾照，并可能使他下赛季取代瓦尔特里·博塔斯 #F1
detailEn:
Herta’s hit the magic 100km for an FP1 Super Licence point, so he’s able to apply for that licence now #F1 #BrazilGPChris Medland: Confirmation from Cadillac of another FP1 outing for Colton Herta at Interlagos, as he goes in search of that final Super Licence point
A clean FP1 with enough running will allow him to apply for a Super Licence, and could see him replace Valtteri Bottas next season #F1
